ontologies.title: MathModDB Knowledge Graph of Mathematical Models | MathModDB
ontologies.description: MathModDB defines a data model with classes (Mathematical Model, Mathematical Expression, Academic Discipline, Research Problem, Quantity (Kind), Computational Task, Scholarly Article), object properties/relations, data properties and annotation properties as an ontology. This ontology is populated with individuals/data from various fields of applied mathematics, making it a knowledge graph
